analysis.title: GS Kamshad - GS TMT TODAY 11.20.26
key_insights: Global risk-off centered on Tech/AI. US futures: Nasdaq -180bps, S&P -90bps, Russell -20bps. Asia: Korea -5%, Japan -5%, HK -2%, HK Tech -4%. Europe -1.5%, Euro Tech -4%. Capital markets activity did not provide the stabilizing force for risk appetite that many had hoped for.
NVDA is -3% and has been lower in 9 of the 10 sessions since the Jensen news broke. SMH is -3.5% and DRAM -5%.
INTU is -10% on a lowered FY Consumer guide (+2-4% y/y vs prior +4-6%) tied to AI risk. Intuit also agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for about $3.68bn.
AAPL is flat and META -2% after Bloomberg reported Apple is building its own autonomous AI agent, based on job listings. The report cites the success of Meta's Muse as the context.
ESTC is -5% on an essentially unchanged F2H outlook despite Cloud acceleration. Annual Elastic Cloud grew +30% CC (from +27%), and cRPO held at +20% CC.
BILL agreed to be acquired by TPG with Corpay at $63.25 per share in cash, about $6.0bn fully diluted equity value. Close is expected in 1H 2027, subject to BILL stockholder and regulatory approval.
Macro: the S&P reversed 3.3% intraday on 11/19, there was no defensive bid, and breadth was poor, with 464 names finishing lower. Rate hike odds are now fully priced.

Fed commentary is hawkish. Goolsbee said 'everything' remains on the table after several months of 'borderline disturbingly high' inflation. Governor Barr signaled further rate adjustments may be warranted. Waller speaks at 8:25am and Cook at 12:15pm.
GS is positive on China Semis and expects the local AI chip market to grow at a +102% CAGR over 2025-30E to US$678bn by 2030E in the base case.

Globant (GLOB): GS expects the stock to be range bound after a narrowed outlook. Middle East demand weakness offsets progress in AI services. AI Pods exit-2026 run-rate ARR is expected at $130mn, up from $110mn.

Keysight FQ4 beat on revenue, margin and EPS. Orders were a record $2,339mn (+12% qoq, +53% yoy reported, +49% organic), with BTB at 1.17x. GS saw order growth as about in line with investor expectations.
GS hosted a hardware and networking bus tour on 11/19 with 650 Group, ANET (Buy), CSCO (Neutral) and SMCI (Sell).
Street action: HSBC upgraded TSLA to Hold. MSFT Ignite conference is on 11/20. BSP reports pre-market.

Stock -3% pre-market and lower in 9 of 10 sessions since the Jensen news broke.
Stock -5% pre-market on an essentially unchanged F2H outlook. Cloud accelerating, but GS wants sustained Cloud momentum and better Observability growth before getting more constructive.
Agreed to be acquired by TPG with Corpay at $63.25 per share in cash. This is the deal price, not a GS price target.
Developing its own autonomous AI agent per Bloomberg, based on job listings. Stock flat.
Stock -2% on reports of Apple's AI agent entry.

GS expects the stock to be range bound after a narrowed outlook. Middle East demand weakness offsets AI initiative progress.

sector_views.rationale: GS is positive. Local AI ecosystem and local-for-local trend are supported by China's AI and semiconductor self-sufficiency push.
INTU's guidance cut on agentic AI risk and ESTC's unchanged outlook show pressure on software, while ESTC Cloud and AI workload usage are improving.

earnings_insights: INTU F1Q (reported): revenue $4.4bn (+12% y/y) against company guide of $4.294-4.313bn (+11% y/y). GBS revenue +15% y/y, Online Ecosystem +20% y/y. Non-GAAP EPS $2.44-2.48 as stated in the note. $1.5bn buyback in the quarter. FY Consumer guide lowered to +2-4% y/y from +4-6%. GBS guide reiterated at +13-14% y/y.

ESTC F2Q (reported): Annual Elastic Cloud +30% CC (from +27%), Sales-Led Subscription Revenue +1.6% above consensus, cRPO +20% CC, operating margin +300bps above consensus. F2H outlook essentially unchanged. About 40% of >$100K customers use Elastic for AI, up from 23% in F2Q26.

KEYS 4QFY26 (reported): revenue $1.99bn, adjusted EBIT margin 35.8%, non-GAAP EPS $3.61. Street estimate was $1.95bn/34.5%/$3.37 and GS estimate $1.95bn/35.0%/$3.39. Orders were a record $2,339mn, BTB 1.17x.
GLOB: Narrowed outlook. AI Pods exit-2026 run-rate ARR expected at $130mn, up from $110mn.

risk_factors: AI disruption risk to software revenue, shown by INTU's guidance cut.
Hawkish Fed with hike odds fully priced and officials saying all options are on the table.
Persistent AI/semiconductor weakness: NVDA lower in 9 of 10 sessions.
Weak breadth and no defensive bid after the 3.3% S&P intraday reversal.
Middle East demand weakness for Globant.

Most active high-touch names: INTC, NVDA, WULF, CMCSA, U, AMZN, QCOM, VIAV, PLTR, DIS, DT, META.
geopolitical: Middle East demand weakness is cited as a headwind for Globant.
GS says local-for-local in China Semis offers better certainty amid geopolitical tension.

tension_points.bull_case: Elastic sees Cloud acceleration and about 40% of >$100K customers using it for AI, and Search is outgrowing the company as AI drives demand for retrieval.
tension_points.bear_case: Intuit cut its FY Consumer guide on AI risk and Elastic's second-half outlook is essentially unchanged, with Observability growth trailing Security and Search.
tension_points.what_invalidates: GS wants sustained Cloud momentum and better Observability growth before getting more constructive on Elastic's Sales-Led Subscription Revenue acceleration.
